speaker: narrator
text: A young boy opens his eyes and finds himself in a peculiar environment

speaker: narrator
text: The boy scans around, the place resembles that of a court room of sorts. Except, unlike a regular courtroom, there were no lights or windows of any kind that would help illuminate the space.

speaker: narrator
text: The young boy still had the ability to see his surroundings and the contents in the room, though, wherever the source of light was originating from was unknown to him.

speaker: narrator
text: Before him was this intimidatingly tall stand that seemed to be stretched across the entire side of the room.

speaker: narrator
text: He turns his head up to find a line of cloaked figures positioned in the stand. The faces of these individuals, obscured by their hoods, were concealed to the boy.

speaker: narrator
text: But thankfully, not everyone in the place had their face shrouded by a hood. As the boy turned beside him and saw that he wasn’t alone.

speaker: narrator
text: Though, that still did little to ease the boy’s overwhelming fear and confusion on his situation.

speaker: reid
text: Reid: “Where am I?! What is this place!? I don’t like it! Caine! Caineeeee!”

speaker: willow
text: Willow: “Reid! Would you stop freaking out for one second?! I can’t properly take in where we are and everything around us if you keep crying!”

speaker: ingot
text: Ingot: “Am I not dead? Are we not dead? Is this what comes after death? What Mamu has given us?”

speaker: illydia
text: Illydia: “This place…these people…we must be careful. We don’t know what could happen to us next.”

speaker: john
text: John: “...So this is what a god can do. Mamu.”

speaker: fursttryl
text: Fursttryl: “Could this be…? My beloved Mamu…!? Am I in the presence of, and being currently seen, by my dear Mamu?!”

speaker: narrator
text: But before another word of confusion can be uttered, the row of cloaked figures, who were earlier merely just standing in pure silence, speak.

speaker: narrator
text: Like a hivemind, they speak in complete, uncanny unison. Only uttering one single word.

speaker: narrator
text: “Worthy”

speaker: narrator
text: Suddenly, Reid jumped as the young child standing right next him vanished into thin air as if they were never there to begin with.

speaker: narrator
text: Young Reid stood there, in pure shock, confusion, and fear at what just occurred before him. He couldn’t hear or focus on anything anymore.

speaker: narrator
text: Too consumed by what he’d just witnessed, all he could do was stand there, as it felt like the world around him disappeared.

speaker: narrator
text: But he wasn’t able to stand there speechless forever as the chorus of hooded figures repeatedly uttered.

speaker: narrator
text: “Worthy”

speaker: narrator
text: And Reid too, disappeared.

speaker: narrator
text: As Reid opens his eyes once more, he finds himself no longer in that peculiar place.

speaker: narrator
text: The elf boy scans around, and unlike before, he knows this place. Reid is all too familiar with this place.

speaker: narrator
text: It’s the place where it all started. The place where he and all the other children were born. The cave.

speaker: narrator
text: As soon as Reid exits the cave, he is immediately embraced by a taller individual. The man holds Reid tight, clearly having been incredibly worried about the little elf.

speaker: narrator
text: The man is none other than Caine, of course.

speaker: narrator
text: Then, as he always does, Reid hugs Caine back and begins to sob uncontrollably into his brother’s arms.

speaker: narrator
text: All I could think when I saw the brothers’ display before me, having just experienced my first ever near-death experience, was simply…

speaker: narrator
text: “Mamu is never wrong. My beloved Mamu is perfect and never wrong…But why was *he* deemed “worthy”?”
